name: exp_dynamicrs_c
summary: This EA implements a dynamic RSI-based mean reversion strategy that identifies overbought and oversold conditions using an adaptive RSI indicator with dynamic threshold levels. It enters trades when RSI signals extreme deviations from the mean and exits upon reversion to neutral zones or when dynamic stop-loss/take-profit levels are hit.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于动态RSI的均值回归策略，通过自适应RSI指标和动态阈值水平来识别超买超卖状态。当RSI信号显示极端偏离均值时入场，在回归中性区域或触发动态止损/止盈时出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用动态RSI（Relative Strength Index）作为核心策略指标，与传统的固定超买超卖阈值不同，它使用动态计算的阈值水平来适应市场波动变化。入场条件为：当RSI跌破动态下阈值时做多，当RSI突破动态上阈值时做空，这体现了均值回归的核心思想——价格极端偏离后将回归均值。出场条件包括RSI回归中性区域时平仓、以及基于ATR或动态计算的止损止盈水平。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，也可能根据账户风险比例动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，动态止损和止盈的设置有助于控制单笔交易的风险敞口，但具体的资金管理策略细节取决于参数配置。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dynamic RSI (Relative Strength Index) as its core strategy indicator, distinguishing itself from traditional fixed overbought/oversold thresholds by using dynamically calculated threshold levels that adapt to changing market volatility. Entry conditions are: go long when RSI drops below the dynamic lower threshold, and go short when RSI breaks above the dynamic upper threshold, embodying the core mean reversion philosophy that extreme price deviations will revert to the mean. Exit conditions include closing positions when RSI returns to the neutral zone, as well as hitting dynamically calculated stop-loss and take-profit levels based on ATR or similar volatility measures. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may also adjust position size dynamically based on account risk percentage. Money management benefits from dynamic stop-loss and take-profit settings that help control risk exposure per trade, though the specifics depend on the parameter configuration.

pros: 动态RSI阈值能自适应市场波动变化，比固定阈值更具灵活性
均值回归策略在震荡行情中表现良好，具有较高的胜率潜力
动态止损止盈机制有助于根据当前市场状况调整风险控制
避免了过度优化固定参数的问题，增强了策略的鲁棒性
pros_en: Dynamic RSI thresholds adapt to changing market volatility, offering more flexibility than fixed thresholds
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets with high win rate potential
Dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms adjust risk control based on current market conditions
Avoids overfitting to fixed parameter values, enhancing strategy robustness
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
动态阈值的计算可能引入滞后性，导致入场时机不够精确
未明确包含加仓或马丁格尔控制，可能在逆势中积累风险
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一RSI指标信号容易产生假突破
cons_en: Mean reversion strategies suffer consecutive losses in strong trending markets, lacking trend filtering
Dynamic threshold calculation may introduce lag, leading to imprecise entry timing
No explicit martingale or position accumulation control, risking buildup against the trend
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single RSI signals are prone to false breakouts
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
加入多时间框架RSI确认，提高信号可靠性并减少假信号
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to avoid counter-trend trading in strong trends
Incorporate multi-timeframe RSI confirmation to improve signal reliability and reduce false signals

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能持续逆势建仓导致较大回撤
动态阈值计算如果参数不当可能在极端行情中失效
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy may continuously build counter-trend positions during trending markets leading to significant drawdown
Dynamic threshold calculation may fail in extreme market conditions if parameters are improperly set
